subject: general
question:
Which term from among the given options can replace the question mark (?) in the following series to make it logically complete?

S 16 H, T 13 J, ?, V 23 N, W 46 P
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First letter → (1) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Number → Alternately (3) is subtracted and multiplied by (2).
 
• Third letter → (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​​So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d0cfc93a51d53c1603cf93d047c52602148585ca1838867eb2810c5d5d96659.png] 

Hence, "**U 26 L**" is the correct answer.
